name: Courtier
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a character: they are drunk for 3 nights & 3 days.
wakes: Each night until the ability is used.
interaction: Shakes head or points at a character icon on the sheet. Not told whether that character is in play.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned when choosing, the ability is spent with no effect. If the Courtier becomes drunk or poisoned during the 3 nights & days, the target sobers up, and is drunk again if the Courtier recovers within the window.

rulings.text: Choosing a not-in-play character does nothing and the ability is still spent.
Drunkenness starts that night and ends at dusk after the third drunk night.
Drunk Mastermind: if the Demon is executed, good wins immediately.
Night order numbers are from the bra1n townsquare roles.json; 0 there is recorded as null.

test_scenarios.name: drunk-demon
test_scenarios.expected: Shabaloth's kills fail on nights 5-7; sober from dusk after night 7's day.

test_scenarios.name: not-in-play
test_scenarios.setup: Courtier, Imp; no Vortox in play.
test_scenarios.expected: Nothing happens; the Courtier has no ability and is not woken again.

test_scenarios.name: drunk-courtier
test_scenarios.expected: The Imp is not drunk; the ability is spent.

test_scenarios.name: courtier-poisoned-mid-window
test_scenarios.setup: Courtier made the Imp drunk on night 2; a Poisoner poisons the Courtier on night 3 only.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 3 the Imp attacks; night 4 the Imp attacks.
test_scenarios.expected: Night 3 kill succeeds (Imp sober); night 4 the Imp is drunk again and the kill fails.
